svg.text: L_NN (VAPMIP, g = 0.2) — the same bundle on the tilted hat: the tip moves, the sheets multiply
Same procedure on the hat of ValaQuenta's L_NN with the coupling −(g/φ)ψ·β. The brim is no longer level (z = 0 is its ring average), so the cone does not stand on a level base.
the brim ring of the untilted hat (tilted by the coupling)
the hilltop of the tilted hat, moved to 0.144 R
lowest sheet: 508 paths, W = 0.7040 ± 0.1844 across them (a level brim gives ± 0)
other sheets: 6 of them (the SM hat has 2)
the tip: 0.0244 R from the tilted hilltop, 0.420 above it; height spread across the sources ± 0.335
